Spline runtime WASM support files
Version: 2.0.37
Source: @splinetool/runtime npm package, build/*.wasm
https://www.npmjs.com/package/@splinetool/runtime
https://spline.design

These files are served locally via Application wasmPath.
process.wasm is required by the current robot mesh. The other runtime WASM
modules are included alongside it for a complete matching support directory.
Keep these files synchronized if the locked Spline runtime version changes.
